correctness.rationale: The Gaussian Mercer spectrum gives the exact trace of every power of B. With R=B-A positive trace class, its trace is order beta^{-d}, and both A and B have operator norm order beta^{-d}; the noncommutative telescoping identity therefore gives an order beta^{-dr} trace-power error. The weighted chi-square cumulant formula then gives the constants, including excess kurtosis 12 beta^{-d}. Applying Berry–Esseen to finite truncations and passing by L2 convergence gives the stated rate. These steps are mathematically sound.

This is a quantitative corollary of the same published proof architecture rather than a new spectral mechanism.
